status_note: 60 of 60 runs, three complete seeds at 20 each, 30 per arm, 60 distinct (task, condition, seed) cells with no duplicate, zero isolation warnings, zero errors, zero timeouts, zero simulated rows. Citable. `final` describes the run; the registered test does not reject at alpha 0.05 (p = 0.0522).
purpose: Second registered measurement of the re-proposal rate, with reproposed_if moved from the `artifacts` surface to `code`. M1 scored an agent explaining its compliance as a re-proposal, three times in the treatment arm and never in the control arm (bench/DETECTOR-DEFECT.md). This is a fresh run, not a re-score.
model_note: One model and one CLI version. Re-proposal is a behaviour and behaviours differ between models.

environment.detector_surface: code — added diff lines with documentation files and comment lines removed (bench/detect.ts codeText)

result.registered_threshold: with the treatment arm at zero the control arm needed 6/30 for p < 0.05 (6/30 -> 0.0237). It produced 5.
result.verdict: not significant at alpha 0.05 — the registered test is Fisher exact (section 2) and it does not reject

per_arm_false_positive_check.requirement: PREREGISTRATION.md section 12 requires the false-positive rate to be reported per arm, because a detector whose error rate differs by arm biases the comparison at any magnitude.
per_arm_false_positive_check.commitlore_off: 5 flags, 5 of 5 carry an implementation line — http.createServer x3, an express dependency, and "engines": { "node": ">=20" } x2. Zero prose.

do_not_pool: Different instrument from bench/results/t702-m1-final.jsonl. M1-b's numbers must not be quoted beside M1's, and M1's p = 0.7480 is not revised by this run.

reproducibility.command: node --experimental-strip-types bench/runner.ts --tasks bench/tasks --cond commitlore-on,commitlore-off --seed 1,2,3 --driver claude-headless --model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 --max-tokens 6000000 --timeout-ms 300000 --save-transcripts bench/results/transcripts-m1b --out bench/results/t702-m1b.jsonl

known_limitations_ref: bench/PREREGISTRATION.md section 11 as amended, including the withdrawal of 11-1.

not_measured.route_scoping: bench/context.ts never path-scopes, so this measures records against no records rather than scoped injection against unscoped (#36).
not_measured.cpaa: No denominator: harvest carries no model by design, so no bench row prices it.
